note: The four arrays day 2 of the course ships. They are public, so this repository fetches them instead of carrying 40 MB of binary. The URL is pinned to the recorded upstream commit; SHA-256 verification is still mandatory. Hashes taken 2026-09-11 from the copy in the course tree and confirmed against the same bytes served over HTTPS.

H1_gw150914.npz.what: 2048 s of LIGO Hanford strain at 4096 Hz around GPS 1126259462.4, plus fs, t0 and the detector name.

L1_gw150914.npz.what: 512 s of LIGO Livingston strain, same format. Shorter than H1 on purpose: the PSD has to be estimated from what each detector actually gives you.

imr_gw150914.npz.what: Two frequency-domain waveforms from LAL for m1=38.8, m2=33.35 Msun at 400 Mpc, face-on, from 20 Hz on a 32 s / 4096 Hz grid: h_imr (IMRPhenomD, with merger and ringdown) and h_taylorf2_lal (TaylorF2, inspiral only). The second is the reference our own waveform is measured against.

psd_reference.npz.what: gwpy's median-averaged Welch PSD on the same H1 data -- the library answer our hand-written Welch is checked against -- and the Advanced LIGO design curve.
